title: rcf define ledger reads and writes the four sidecars under rcf/define/
description: User story under REQ-173. The operator-facing CLI for the four sidecar ledgers lands with add / resolve / list on every ledger name.
asA: an operator staging or reviewing a DEFINE change
iWant: rcf define ledger to author brief statements, decisions, concern dispositions and probe findings under rcf/define/ with numbered ids stable for the life of the project, and to leave every ledger invisible to the walker
soThat: the freeze record's high-water mark, the D7 decisions list, D5 concern coverage and D6 probe findings all have a written record and every later DEFINE slice reads the same seam without discovering a second source of truth

acceptanceCriteria.description: rcf define ledger brief add --kind <k> --text <t> appends a numbered statement to rcf/define/brief-ledger.json, mints the next id (highest current + 1), stamps status open and addedAt (ISO-8601), refuses an unknown kind with a usage-class error, and refuses --text combined with --from with a usage-class error.

rcf define ledger decisions list prints the numbered #241 format: one decision per item (id. question), options rendered as 'letter) text', the default letter labelled 'default:', and what it blocks labelled 'blocks:'. rcf define ledger <name> list --json emits the machine-readable envelope { ledger, <arrayKey>: [...] }.

rcf define ledger brief add --from <file> reads the file, splits it into one statement per non-empty line (stripping leading '- ', '* ' or '<n>. ' bullets), mints sequential ids for every statement, refuses if the file produced zero non-empty lines, and stamps the file path as source unless --source overrides it. The intake-scan-against-frozen-statements hook is a named seam in the writer, not called in this slice.

walkTree run over a project that carries rcf/define/freeze.json, all four ledger files, and a bug-bait file named req-999.json under rcf/define/ never surfaces any rcf/define/ file as a tree.byId document and reports no walker error naming a rcf/define/ path. The sidecar directory is invisible to every consumer of walkTree.
